Basic personal info
- Full name: Million Manhoef.
- Birth year: 2002 (born 2001/2002 — commonly listed as 2002).
- Nationality: Dutch. Of Surinamese descent.
- Family: He is the son of Melvin Manhoef, a well‑known Dutch–Surinamese mixed martial artist and kickboxer.

Club career
- Youth development: Came through the Vitesse Arnhem (SBV Vitesse) youth academy.
- Senior club: Broke into Vitesse’s first team and has been primarily associated with Vitesse in the Eredivisie. He is typically deployed on the right flank — as an attacking fullback/wing‑back or wide midfielder/winger.
- Role: Known for pace, directness, dribbling and goal/assist threat from the flank. Often used in an advanced wing‑back role in formations that allow him to get forward frequently.
- Shirt number: He has been seen wearing a forward/wing number for Vitesse (often low number like 7 or similar), but exact number can vary by season.

International career
- Youth level: Represented the Netherlands at various youth levels (Netherlands U16/U18/U21 at different times).
- Senior national team: Eligible for the Netherlands and Suriname due to heritage. As of mid‑2024 he was primarily associated with Dutch youth teams; any senior caps should be checked against the latest match records.

Playing style and strengths
- Speed and acceleration: One of his standout attributes; he often outruns opponents on the flank.
- Dribbling and directness: Likes to take defenders on and create chances by beating his marker.
- Versatility on the right: Can play as a right wing‑back, right winger or wide midfielder depending on tactical needs.
- Offensive output: Contributes goals and assists more than you’d expect from a conventional fullback, thanks to his attacking instincts.

Notable points and context
- Sporting profile: Seen as one of the promising young Dutch talents emerging from the Eredivisie, with interest from supporters and scouts because of his athletic profile and attacking output.
- Heritage/family notoriety: His father’s profile in combat sports brings additional public interest to Million.
